name: io.github.kisasa/shopify-mcp
title: Shopify
description: Shopify Admin API tools: products, media, orders, customers, inventory, and sales channels

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Static Admin API access token (shpat_...) for legacy custom apps, instead of client ID/secret
